title: add-rag-agent-templates-and-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Add new RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates and new example apps. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Provide out-of-the-box RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to reduce onboarding time for developers integrating Redwood agents with external tools and knowledge sources. This PR introduces agent templates (python/ts), two runnable quickstarts demonstrating tool calling (ticketing + search), and docs site updates including parameter reference, architecture diagram, and a short migration note.

What changed (high level):
- added /docs/agents/rag-templates.md with curated templates and recommended prompting patterns
- added /examples/agents/rag-ticketing-quickstart (Python) demonstrating tool-calling with the ticketing API and safe fallback behavior
- added /examples/agents/rag-search-quickstart (TypeScript) showing prefix caching, chunking, and model fallback configuration
- updated docs site navigation and sidebar to surface agent quickstarts and templates
- small update to SDK usage examples to include agent.run_tool_call and structured output validation

Checklist: [x] docs written and linted with doc-builder [x] example apps test locally under examples CI [x] architecture diagram included [x] internal reviewers addressed comments

Commits (summary): 5 commits - initial templates and quickstarts; docs site wiring; add example tests; address review comments; squash + fixups before merge.

Context/notes: The templates include recommended batching/ KV-cache settings for RAG workloads and a short note about cost/latency tradeoffs. The quickstarts are intentionally small (under 200 LOC each) but include a mocked external tool adapter and instructions for wiring a real service. The docs page includes step-by-step setup, expected request/response examples, and a small troubleshooting section.
